title: The Tent Pegs and the Pole
youtube_title: The Tent Pegs and the Pole | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A fiddly job goes well when two people take slow halves.
summary: At a school hall being set for a gentle fair, a small tent's pole and pegs will go wrong if one person rushes. Ilaria and Opal split it into two slow jobs, while Grandpa Sol only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
